title: Select mounts the moving current follower without a long pause

verification.actor: Saved current Follower Mankey species 56, party slot 2, then the same live Mounted actor
verification.trigger: Hold Right for four completed game frames, press Select with Right still held while both the stock player step and follower Hop are moving, and continue to hold Right
verification.observable: A native Select edge reaches the same mounted actor within eight completed game frames; Right input remains held; a later mounted Hop commits and reaches IDLE with control returned
limits: The unchanged test.sav supplies the current saved Mankey; no party, follower, profile, map or timer state is prepared.
This is one normal mid-run Select and one mounted Hop, not a broad timing matrix or long reliability soak.
The latency uses completed main-task-queue game frames, not video cycles or host time.

events.value: Read the saved current Mankey follower and wait until it is settled
Hold Right for four completed game frames, then press Select for one frame while Right stays held
Keep Right held through mount, start one mounted Hop, then release input and wait for its terminal state

stop.condition: The same actor mounts within eight completed frames of Select and one mounted Hop ends in IDLE, or the first invalid observation

invariants: Each accepted motion has exactly one terminal result
No logical commit occurs after motion cancellation
Control returns after the selected motion finishes or cancels
No active actors share a nonzero target reservation
Every active actor handle uses the current field epoch
Every active actor has an attached presentation
